title: Verify accelerator pedal sensor voltage range monitoring
objective: Confirm ECU raises DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch when APS voltage is out of range
preconditions: ECU powered; APS simulator connected; logging enabled
steps:
1. Set APS primary channel to 0.3V (below 0.5V lower bound)
2. Wait 20ms
3. Check diagnostic event log
4. Set APS primary to 4.7V (above 4.5V upper bound)
5. Wait 20ms
6. Check diagnostic event log
expected_result: DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch raised within 20ms for both fault injections; event logged with timestamp ±1ms

title: Verify torque reduction safe state transition time
objective: Confirm engine torque reaches 0 Nm within 20ms of latched APS mismatch event
preconditions: ECU running; torque simulator active; oscilloscope on torque output
steps: 1. Latch DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch via fault injection\n2. Record timestamp T0\n3. Measure engine torque output at T0+20ms
expected_result: Engine torque ≤ 0 Nm at T0+20ms; safe state flag set in ECU status register

title: Verify CAN bus latency under normal load
objective: Confirm end-to-end CAN message latency stays within 5ms at nominal load
preconditions: CAN network at 80% utilisation; all ECU nodes active
steps: 1. Inject 100 CAN messages from ECU-A\n2. Measure arrival time at ECU-B for each message\n3. Calculate 95th-percentile latency

title: Verify CAN error burst logging
objective: Confirm CAN errors above 10/s burst rate are logged to persistent storage
preconditions: CAN error injection tool connected; NVM logging enabled
steps: 1. Inject 15 CAN errors within 1 second\n2. Wait 500ms\n3. Read NVM error log
expected_result: At least 15 error entries written to NVM; each entry includes CAN ID, error type, and timestamp

title: Verify system input response time
objective: Confirm system responds to driver input within 50ms
preconditions: System fully booted; input event generator connected
steps: 1. Send 50 random driver input events spaced 200ms apart\n2. Record request and response timestamps
expected_result: All responses received within 50ms; no missed events

title: Verify steering angle sensor redundancy check
objective: Confirm plausibility fault raised when primary and secondary sensors diverge beyond ±2°
preconditions: Dual steering angle sensor simulator; ECU logging enabled
steps:
1. Set primary sensor to 10°, secondary to 10° (nominal)
2. Confirm no fault
3. Set secondary to 13° (3° deviation)
4. Wait 10ms
expected_result: No fault at step 2; SteeringAngle_Mismatch fault raised within 10ms at step 4

title: Verify diagnostic event timestamp accuracy
objective: Confirm logged event timestamps are accurate to ±1ms
preconditions: GPS-synchronised time reference connected; ECU logging enabled
steps: 1. Trigger 10 diagnostic events at known times\n2. Compare logged timestamps to reference
expected_result: All timestamps within ±1ms of reference time

title: Verify brake pressure sensor sampling rate
objective: Confirm brake pressure sensor sampled at ≥20ms cycle and validated against vehicle speed
preconditions: HIL rig; brake pressure simulator; vehicle speed simulator
steps:
1. Set brake pressure to nominal value
2. Set vehicle speed to 80 km/h
3. Monitor sample timestamps for 1000ms
4. Inject implausible brake pressure spike while speed = 0 km/h
expected_result: Sample interval ≤ 20ms in all 50+ cycles; plausibility fault raised on spike injection
